definitions.short: Jahats or Jahtsah , a place East of the Jordan
definitions.full: H3096. Yahats יַ֫הְצָה יַ֫הַץ, proper name, of a location in Moab , site unknown (MI 19, 20 יהץ ) — יהץ Isa 15:4 ; Jer 48:34 ; with ה locative יָהְ֑צָה , on border of territory of Amorites (under Sihon) Num 21:23 ; Deut 2:32 ; also בְּיָהְ֑צָה Judg 11:20 ; called יַהֲצָ֫ה Josh 13:18 (assigned to Reuben); יַ֫הְצָה 1Chr 6:63 (Levitical city in Reuben), Jer 48:21 . יהר (√ of following; compare Late Hebrew יָהַר Hithpa`el shew oneself haughty , adjective יָהִיר ; Aramaic יְהַר Pa`el be haughty , adjective יְהִירָא ; compare Arabic be insane ).
definitions.rootNote: or יַהְצָה ; or (feminine) יַהְצָה ; from an unused root meaning to stamp ; perhaps threshing -floor;
